datasheet: Semtech SX1280/SX1281 Data Sheet DS.SX1280-1.W.APP Rev 3.2 March 2020 (${OPENDRONE_LIB}/datasheet/SX1281IMLTRT.pdf, covers SX1280IMLTRT): 17.3 Land Pattern Fig 17-3 p153 (C 4.00, X 0.30, Y 0.80, Z 4.80, G 3.20, P 0.50, H=K 2.70 EP land); body Fig 17-1 p152 (D=E 4.00, D1=E1 2.60, L 0.40, b 0.23); pins Table 2-1 p17 (exposed pad = 'pin 0', numbered 25 here as in the OpenDrone footprint/symbol)
derivation: IPC-7351 least density (L) variant of lib:QFN-24_L4.0-W4.0-P0.50-TL-EP2.6_Dense (D109, D101 full land set): toe 2.08 (D 3.90/4.00/4.10 -> 2.05 max + 0.03), heel 1.60 kept (>= D/2-Lmax 1.55), width 0.24 (IPC L side, b 0.18/0.23/0.30), EP 2.70/paste unchanged. Rule: outer land edge = max(terminal end nominal + 0.05, terminal end at max package tolerance + 0.03), capped at nominal + 0.15; heel kept unless it ran past D/2 - Lmax; side = max(IPC-7351B L X, b nominal), never wider than the original; courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10. Origin, pad numbers, EP/paste/mask and 3D model unchanged. Base derivation: Dense change (only one): toe shortened, outer land edge 2.40 -> 2.20 (Z 4.80 -> 4.40, 0.20 past the body edge = IPC-7351B density L toe) to meet the area budget QFN24_4 4.4 x 4.4 (DESIGN-SPEC 9.2, budget_v6, sketch_v5 SX1280 rectangle 4.4 x 4.4); heel edge kept at G/2 = 1.60 = lead heel (D/2 - L), width 0.30, pitch, EP 2.70 and paste unchanged. Safe: bottom-only terminations need no toe fillet (IPC-A-610 class 2), the joint is the lead length under the land (0.40 nominal) plus 0.20 toe; X-ray inspection as for every EP part (DESIGN-SPEC 'Exposed pads and X-ray'); no pins trimmed (none are NC)
